info.comment: Flat vector food product: memo rye slice. Two stacked rectangular rye bread slices, brown-gray #8B6F4E, with simple seed dots, resting on a white napkin and navy plate. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, no text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges. Palette: navy #1B3A6B, blue #2F6FED, rye brown, white, gray.
